description: This Dart file defines the BudgetDao class, providing data access methods for budget-related data in a Flutter application using the sqflite package. It includes methods to query budgets with spent amounts, upsert budgets, and fetch categories.

classes.name: BudgetDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling budget data, providing methods to query budgets, insert or update budgets, and retrieve categories.

methods.name: budgetsWithSpent
methods.description: Fetches budgets along with the total spent per category for a specific month.

methods.name: upsertBudget
methods.description: Inserts or replaces a budget record for a given category and month.

methods.name: allCategories
methods.description: Retrieves all categories sorted by name, to support adding new budgets.
